gist.summary: Added paid-only meta/muse-wonder-1.0 for text and image input, text output, mandatory reasoning, structured output, streaming, and tools with tool_choice set to auto. Its context window is 1,048,576 tokens; pricing is per 1 million input, cached input, and output tokens, with reasoning billed at the output rate. Requests use OpenRouter pinned to Meta, with Meta-hosted Vercel AI Gateway as fallback; wallet charges retain the OpenRouter quote when fallback is used. In local tests, OpenRouter answered most calls in 1–2 seconds, while JSON-schema output took 30–100 seconds versus about 7 seconds for json_object. Vercel returned 503 on 3 of 6 calls and stalled for 290 seconds on image and JSON requests.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
